dataset: BTCUSDT 15m user CSV May-September2026; SHA verified, origin not independently authenticated
development: 2026-05-01 to 2026-08-01 exclusive; first500 bars warm-up only
test: 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-01 exclusive; past8832 bars allowed for indicators; fresh ledger

A.name: Donchian ATR
A.entry: close breaks prior20 highs/lows excluding current

B.name: EMA trend
B.entry: EMA20>EMA50 and close>EMA20 LONG; inverse SHORT; persistent alignment, not crossover-only
B.exit: EMA alignment reverses or price loses EMA20

C.name: RSI regime reversion
C.entry: RSI returns above30 LONG or below70 SHORT; ADX<=20 and abs(EMA20-EMA50)/ATR<=0.5

D.name: Aura indicators alternative
D.entry: EMA alignment + RSI55/45 + MACD histogram sign + volume>=past20 mean; no Fibonacci or divergence claim
D.exit: EMA reverses, RSI loses50 or MACD histogram sign changes

regimes: closed-candle ADX14<=20 RANGE, >=25 TREND, otherwise TRANSITION; entry-time attribution only, not future regimes
execution: Unchanged Lab Decimal simulate. Closed signal, next open fills, fixed ATR distances from signal close centered on actual fill, stop-gap adverse, target-gap capped, both hits stop-first; max1; ignore occupied entries; no same-open reversal. Same initial/risk/notional/collateral rules. Fixed final segment liquidation; monthly positions carry.
buy_hold: Reuse precommitted passive capped2000 and budget10000; same costs but no SL and not risk-equivalent
historical_pattern: Reuse COMPLETE prior production-native replay only when CSV, all native software hashes, dates, default PatternConfig and paper settings match. Separate unranked close-fill/no-slippage reference, not substituted for next-open execution.
limits: Existing CSV16MiB/20000 rows; standalone CPU180s. No paid services, no web/UI/API/production state changes. No parameter search. Sensitivity does not choose parameters.
